name: @gradusmusic/notation-mcp
description: Three Gradus music tools for AI agents in one MCP server: Gradus Notation (render scores to SVG/MusicXML/MIDI), the Gradus Harmonic Analyzer (Roman numerals, keys, cadences, texture), and the Gradus Engraver (checks against a citable engraving rulebook). General-purpose — for any agent or application that works with music. Free, no auth. Gradus is a music-composition curriculum for homeschool families; it builds and gives away free music tools for AI agents.
author: Sean Johnson — Gradus School of Music Composition
